# Synthetic release tree

All content below is invented. The test harness materializes each named file
verbatim in a temporary release checkout. A Markdown specimen uses the existing
fixture scanner's documented README rule; it is not room-cli response data.

synthetic_assumptions: the Rust environment names, colour literals and local
settings ignore entries below are invented public-code specimens.
The harness expands `SYNTHETIC_ENV_PREFIX` in code blocks to the lowercase Rust
environment-name prefix before writing the tree, preserving these specimens
without storing them as literal identifiers in the fixture source.

## src/main.rs

```text
fn main() {
    println!("Usage: openwiz --help");
}

#[test]
fn synthetic_proof() {
    const ENV_LOG_FILE: &str = "environment.log";
    const ENV_PREFIXES: &[&str] = &["SYNTHETIC_"];
    let SYNTHETIC_ENV_PREFIXhost = None::<String>;
    let mut command = std::process::Command::new("synthetic");
    command.SYNTHETIC_ENV_PREFIXremove("SYNTHETIC").SYNTHETIC_ENV_PREFIXclear();
    let _ = (SYNTHETIC_ENV_PREFIXhost, ENV_LOG_FILE, ENV_PREFIXES);
    assert_eq!(2 + 2, 4);
}
```
